item.title: Prince Albert sends condolences to Spain after deadly train crash
item.description: Prince Albert II has expressed his shock and sadness following the train crash in southern Spain that killed at least 39 people on Sunday.

item.title: What is the EU trade ‘bazooka’ that could hit back at Trump?
item.description: The European Union is facing calls to deploy a powerful but untested trade tool following US President Donald Trump's threat to impose tariffs of up to 25% on multiple European nations over Greenland.

item.title: Mayor Georges Marsan presents La Mairie’s vision for 2026
item.description: Mayor Georges Marsan, accompanied by several members of the Town Council, presented ambitious plans for the principality during his annual New Year address to the press this morning.

item.title: Prince Albert II helps launch WRC season ahead of Rally Monte-Carlo
item.description: Prince Albert II of Monaco joined rally pilots, motorsport teams and fans on Saturday, as the World Rally Championship presented its 2026 campaign on Port Hercule.

item.title: Trump’s ultimatum: Join my peace board or face 200% wine tariffs
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a 200% tariff on French wines and champagnes in an attempt to pressure President Emmanuel Macron into joining his 'Board of Peace' initiative.

item.title: Forbes Travel Guide Summit set to return to Monaco in February
item.description: The Grimaldi Forum will welcome the Forbes Travel Guide Summit from February 24th to 27th, uniting senior figures from the global luxury hospitality sector.

item.title: Monaco Biennale to spotlight paediatric cancer breakthroughs and AI innovation
item.description: The 17ᵗʰ Biennale Monégasque de Cancérologie will return to the Grimaldi Forum with a landmark focus on paediatric oncology and artificial intelligence in cancer care.

item.title: Women’s rights in Monaco: A snapshot of progress and challenges in 2025
item.description: Monaco's gender violence victims ranged from age 6 to 80 in 2025, with reported cases rising from 35 to 40, the Committee for the Promotion and Protection of Women's Rights revealed Tuesday.

item.title: Von der Leyen declares era of European independence as Trump’s threats mount
item.description: Speaking on Tuesday, von der Leyen framed the current geopolitical upheaval not as a crisis to be weathered, but as a permanent shift requiring permanent European transformation.

item.title: Football: Kylian Mbappé and Real Madrid subject Monaco to historic defeat
item.description: AS Monaco suffered their heaviest defeat in European football at the hands of Real Madrid on a sombre night for the Principality club (6-1) at the Bernabéu.
